tools.name: list_intents
tools.description: List 100 buyer-agent transaction intents with supply status. 99 of 100 have no verified supply partner. Ranking is editorial, not measured demand.

tools.name: get_intent
tools.description: Get one intent: required context, decision factors, honest supply status and policy. Never asserts prices or vendors.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Supply catalog with dated verified facts and an explicit list of unverified fields. Currently one partner.

tools.name: match_workload
tools.description: Deterministic, explainable match or rejection for a workload. No scores, no invented numbers.
